name: brand-api
description: Find real brand references, extract any website's brand system, and check how closely a page follows a brand.

interface.shortDescription: Brand references, brand systems, and brand checks
interface.longDescription: Brand API turns a website URL into a structured brand system: colors, typography, layout and components, plus the captured HTML, CSS and screenshots. Search a curated corpus of brand sites by aesthetic, build new pages inside an existing brand, and score how closely a page follows it. Ships with three skills: brand-search, taste-director and brand-adherence.
defaultPrompt: Find brands with a warm pastel skincare look
Extract the brand system of stripe.com
